convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom() to load a custom indicator 'DecEMA' and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution. Signal logic requires the custom indicator's buffer values.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before processing
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade timing

derived_values.name: Value[0], Value[1], Value[2] - DecEMA buffer values at SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2

other_exits: Buy position closes when DecEMA[SignalBar+1] > DecEMA[SignalBar+2] (downtrend detected) and BuyPosClose input is true
Sell position closes when DecEMA[SignalBar+1] < DecEMA[SignalBar+2] (uptrend detected) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of margin/balance (MM as percentage). Default is LOT mode with 0.1 lots.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses a two-tier comparison: first checks trend direction by comparing Value[1] vs Value[2] (DecEMA at SignalBar+1 vs SignalBar+2), then checks for crossover by comparing Value[0] vs Value[1] (DecEMA at SignalBar vs SignalBar+1). Long entry requires downtrend (Value[1]<Value[2]) AND crossover up (Value[0]>Value[1]). Short entry requires uptrend (Value[1]>Value[2]) AND crossover down (Value[0]<Value[1]). This is a trend-reversal-with-confirmation pattern. SignalBar=1 means signals are calculated on the previous completed bar, not the current forming bar. Trade functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) are from TradeAlgorithms.mqh and handle position management internally. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit suggests the trade library stores global variables for state tracking.
